Select top(5)* from BUSC.DELTA_REF_TBL where TABLENAME like 'DEP_%';

SELECT COUNT(1) DUP_CNT FROM (
    SELECT ACN_ID, CARD_ACCT_NBR, count(1) CNT FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARDP 
    WHERE islatest = 1
    GROUP BY CARD_NBR, CARD_ACCT_NBR
HAVING count(1) > 1 ) A;

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_WITH_DUP_20240319
FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER; --Target table to remove duplicate
Select getdate();
with src as(
    select 1 as [ACN_ID],'2023-04-03T00:00:00.0000000' as [INSERT_DTTM],'CBC01_ATM_ACCOUNT_001_20230331.csv' as [FILE_NAME]
    union ALL
    select 1 as [ACN_ID],'2024-01-18T00:00:00.0000000' as [INSERT_DTTM],'CBC01_ATM_ACCOUNT_001_20231130.csv' as[FILE_NAME]
    union ALL
    select 1 as [ACN_ID],'2024-01-30T00:00:00.0000000' as [INSERT_DTTM],'CBC01_ATM_ACCOUNT_001_20231229.csv' as[FILE_NAME]
    union ALL
    select 1 as [ACN_ID],'2024-02-12T00:00:00.0000000' as [INSERT_DTTM],'CBC01_ATM_ACCOUNT_001_20240313.csv' as[FILE_NAME]
    union ALL
    select 1 as [ACN_ID],'2024-03-14T00:00:00.0000000' as [INSERT_DTTM],'CBC01_ATM_ACCOUNT_001_20240228.csv' as[FILE_NAME]
)
select ROW_NUMBER() over(partition by ACN_ID order by FILE_NAME desc,INSERT_DTTM desc) rn,* from src;
